reading.title: Scorpio Sun, Libran Moon, Fixed Leo Fire
overview: The Sun at 14° Scorpio conjoins Mercury retrograde while the Moon at 16° Libra moves toward a sextile with Mars. Venus rules the Moon from 24° Libra retrograde and forms a close sextile to Jupiter at 25° Leo, where Mars also conjoins Jupiter. Outer-planet aspects include Neptune sextile Pluto, Uranus trine Pluto, and Saturn conjunct Neptune, all within a few degrees.

Mundane tradition reads the Scorpio Sun-Mercury conjunction as heightened focus on shared resources and intelligence matters, while the Venus-Jupiter sextile and Mars-Jupiter conjunction point to diplomatic or financial overtures that may expand or overreach. The Saturn-Neptune conjunction in Aries suggests institutional erosion or crises of confidence, and the Moon's next aspect to Mars indicates short-term activation of alliances or military posture.

Transits to national angles remain within the stated two-degree window for several charts, notably Neptune opposite the US MC, Pluto conjunct China's Moon and ASC, and various Saturn and Uranus contacts to Russia, Ukraine, Israel, Iran, Taiwan and North Korea. The recent Libra new moon fell in the eleventh house for the US and the sixth for Russia, Ukraine, Israel and Iran.

nations.reading: Neptune opposes the Sibly MC while Saturn sextiles natal Uranus and Mars sextiles natal Mars. These contacts coincide with reporting on US midterms and naval acquisition issues, though the fair-test record shows Mars affliction timing no better than chance for conflict indicators.

Neptune squares the natal Sun, Pluto conjoins natal Saturn, and Mars squares natal Pluto. The Libra new moon sat in the sixth house; today's aspects overlap with coverage of negotiations and information shortages, yet Mars-related tests against personnel-loss claims remain indistinguishable from chance.

Pluto conjoins natal Saturn and Neptune sextiles it; the Libra new moon again fell in the sixth house. Reporting on upcoming talks aligns with the Venus-Jupiter and Mars-Jupiter contacts, but the multi-year record finds Mars affliction and lunation effects on air-raid data no better than chance.

Saturn squares the natal Sun and Uranus opposes natal Jupiter. The new moon occupied the fourth house; election-market questions appear in the listed overlaps, with no angular data available for tighter assessment.

reading.lore_and_intel: Venus sextile Jupiter and Mars conjunction Jupiter overlap with reporting on Ukraine negotiations and Iranian information constraints; Neptune sextile Pluto and Uranus trine Pluto coincide with European hoax threats and Taiwan election markets; Sun-Mercury and Mercury-Pluto aspects touch White House event spikes and Hormuz shipping incidents. Saturn-Neptune and US MC contacts appear with midterms commentary. No overlaps are recorded for several other listed aspects or nations, and the fair tests cited below cover only the specific claims examined.

watch.note: Mercury stations direct; Venus stations direct

reading.the_test: Mars affliction versus Ukraine air-raid alarms, Israel alerts and Russian losses showed differences of -1 % to +2 % from chance across thousands of days. Full-moon and eclipse tests against the same indicators and worldwide magnitude-6+ earthquakes likewise returned results no better than chance after correction for multiple comparisons.
